name: The mystery
approved_voiceover: What if I told you a Ghana Premier League club kept 24 clean sheets in 34 matches... and still didn't win the title?

name: Just 15 conceded
approved_voiceover: In the 2025/26 season, Hearts of Oak conceded just 15 goals throughout the entire league campaign.

name: 24 clean sheets
approved_voiceover: They kept an incredible 24 clean sheets.

name: 13 of 24 ended 0–0
approved_voiceover: But here's the surprising part. 13 of those clean sheets ended in goalless draws.

name: Neither team scored
approved_voiceover: Thirteen matches where their opponents couldn't score... but neither could Hearts.

name: Defence is not attack
approved_voiceover: And that's the problem. Football isn't just about stopping goals. You also have to score them.

name: 25 in 34
approved_voiceover: Hearts managed only 25 goals in 34 matches.

name: Below league average
approved_voiceover: That's an average of just 0.74 goals per game, compared to the league average of 1.02.

name: 18 without a goal
approved_voiceover: In fact, they failed to score in 18 matches.

name: Equal defeats
approved_voiceover: Now, compare that with the eventual champions, Medeama. Both clubs lost exactly six matches.

name: Wins separate them
approved_voiceover: But while Medeama won 17 games, Hearts managed just 13.

name: Eight-point gap
approved_voiceover: And that difference in wins and draws left Hearts eight points behind the champions.

name: The takeaway
approved_voiceover: Hearts had an extraordinary defence. But they couldn't turn enough of those clean sheets into victories.

name: GilB signature
approved_voiceover: Unpacked by GilB. There's more to the story.
